name: Anthropic /code-review
model_policy: hard-pins by role, independent of session model: 5 parallel Sonnet review agents (step 4); Haiku for eligibility, CLAUDE.md path discovery, PR summary, per-issue confidence scoring, and the re-check (steps 1/2/3/5/7). No Opus subagents — only the orchestrator runs on the session model
invocation: Use the Skill tool to run `code-review:code-review` — the plugin-qualified command from code-review@claude-plugins-official. It is NOT `decaf-quality:code-review`: a different tool ships a skill of the same bare name, so never invoke a bare `/code-review`, and abort rather than substituting anything else if the qualified skill does not resolve. Review pull request #{PR} of the GitHub repository {REPO}. Do NOT pass --comment and do NOT post anything to GitHub — output the review to the terminal only. Fetch the PR with gh. Print every finding you would post, with file:line references.

name: obra/superpowers requesting-code-review
model_policy: session model; one general-purpose reviewer subagent
invocation: Using the superpowers requesting-code-review skill and its code-reviewer.md prompt template, dispatch ONE general-purpose subagent to review the code changes in this repository from commit {BASE} to commit {HEAD} (i.e. `git diff {BASE} {HEAD}`). Give it the PR title and the diff range as context. Return the reviewer subagent's full report verbatim (Strengths / Critical / Important / Minor / Assessment).

name: decaf-quality-dev:code-review (bugs, --report)
install_hint: cp -rL decaf-quality ~/.claude/skills/decaf-quality-dev, rename the plugin to decaf-quality-dev in .claude-plugin/plugin.json, and rewrite every 'decaf-quality:' reference inside the copy to 'decaf-quality-dev:' — the skill dispatches agents by fully-qualified name and will otherwise pull the stable plugin's agents into a run of the new orchestrator
model_policy: set by the bugs preset; see code-review SKILL.md 'Presets'
invocation: Use the Skill tool to run /decaf-quality-dev:code-review with arguments: bugs --report {PR}. This reviews pull request #{PR} of the GitHub repository {REPO} (its origin remote). This is REVIEW-ONLY: never post any comment, review, or status to the PR. When finished, print the path of the generated review file under .decaf/code-reviews/ and a one-line count of findings by severity.
baseline_note: Not comparable to the archived `ours` cells: those ran the pre-axis skill at mid --report, before the roster, models, evidence and reach axes existed.
subjects_note: one per size class (1 small, 5 medium, 9 large) — enough to compare presets on identical code and to exercise the size-derived roster across all three bands

name: decaf-quality-dev:code-review (bugs-sp, --report)
install_hint: scripts/install-dev-plugin.sh — snapshots decaf-quality from the working tree into ~/.claude/skills/decaf-quality-dev with the namespace rewrite; re-run after any edit to decaf-quality/
model_policy: session model; ONE solo-reviewer subagent (roster=1). No volume, verification, or clustering agents — the seat self-calibrates and its anchors are final. See code-review SKILL.md 'The bugs-sp path' and v2/analysis/PROPOSAL-BUGS-SP.md
invocation: Use the Skill tool to run /decaf-quality-dev:code-review with arguments: bugs-sp --report {PR}. This reviews pull request #{PR} of the GitHub repository {REPO} (its origin remote). This is REVIEW-ONLY: never post any comment, review, or status to the PR. When finished, print the path of the generated review file under .decaf/code-reviews/ and a one-line count of findings by severity.
baseline_note: Experimental arm (nib dcc-1sbc), added 2026-08-16 — after the v2 pilot. The ours-* pilot cells (2026-08-12) predate this preset and are the comparison baselines; no existing cell ran it.
subjects_note: experiment scoped to the two v2 pilot subjects (prometheus/prometheus#18081, dotnet/efcore#34127) x 2 repeats, per PROPOSAL-BUGS-SP.md; success criteria live there
